name: Trip Importer
author: self-hosted
description: Reconstruct one or more past trips from Polarsteps exports — select multiple detected journeys and each becomes its own trip, auto-scoped to its own dates, with the step photos imported too. Also imports booking PDFs/ICS invites, GPS photos, Google Photos Takeout, GPX/KML tracks, expense CSVs and Google Maps timeline, all date-matched to the right trip instead of dumped into one. Creates the trip, journal, places, day notes, transports, accommodations and costs automatically — with one-click undo.
